# AI-Ready RevOps

> AI-Ready RevOps is a diagnostic and remediation methodology for B2B SaaS revenue stacks.
> It scores AI readiness across six weighted dimensions, producing a 0–100 Readiness Index.
> Founded by Vinay Raghavendran, an independent Salesforce architect and RevOps consultant
> with 13 years of experience across enterprise CRM, integration architecture, and revenue operations.

## About

AI-Ready RevOps addresses the dominant 2026 RevOps problem: companies buying AI tools
on top of broken data foundations, compounding waste rather than generating ROI.
The framework quantifies exactly where AI spend is leaking and identifies the highest-recovery fixes.

## Framework

Six dimensions, each scored 1–5 across four criteria, weighted into a single index:

- Data Foundation (20%): Field completeness, picklist discipline, deduplication, data ownership
- AI Stack Fit (20%): Tool inventory, ROI tracking, adoption, data pipeline quality
- Integration Architecture (15%): System-of-record clarity, sync health, data lineage
- Process Standardization (15%): Lead-to-cash, stage exit criteria, MQL/SQL alignment, handoff SLAs
- Governance & Access (15%): Connected apps, OAuth grants, profiles, audit trails
- Forecasting Trust (15%): Accuracy, pipeline hygiene, methodology, leadership confidence

Readiness bands: AI-Premature (0–20), AI-Risky (21–40), AI-Cautious (41–60), AI-Approaching (61–80), AI-Ready (81–100)
